claims: C1 a tool is a program that can be called by the assistant to perform a specific task
C2 typically the assistant determines which tools, if any, are appropriate for the task at hand

concepts.name: tool_definition
concepts.gloss: T is a program that can be called by the assistant to perform a specific task, such as retrieving web pages or generating images

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document

concepts.name: determines_appropriate
concepts.gloss: assistant A determines that tool T is appropriate for the task at hand
concepts.inference: the clause says it is up to the assistant to determine which tools are appropriate, so a relation between assistant, tool, and task is needed

concepts.name: task_at_hand
concepts.gloss: the task at hand for which the assistant may choose tools
concepts.inference: the clause refers to 'the task at hand' as the object of the appropriateness determination

ontology.gloss: T is a tool: a program the assistant can call to perform a specific task
